verdict.rationale: A business register portal could reasonably document a path for non-resident founders, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party guidance on non-resident eligibility, acceptable foreign identity credentials, or extra steps. A multilingual language selector and a pointer to international LEI issuers are adjacent features and do not document a non-resident path for completing the task.

support.subject: As a foreign founder, the service documents a path for a non-resident to complete this task — eligibility, acceptable foreign credentials or identifiers, and any extra steps stated on its own pages
